answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than a brief pulse of activity. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, weighted by reciprocal endorsements and transitive trust, leaves freshly spawned sybil identities with near-zero eigenvector centrality; they cannot pass consensus by multiplying accounts. A velvet reputation veneer cannot turn a new identity into a trusted garden.
